name: wp-ja-kinetic/category-card-part
title: Category card part
description: One piece of the Engineering category card (`.hxcat-row`, `category/thumbs_item.php:48-58`) that no core block renders in the source's shape: `cover` — the intro image as the row's `background-image` on an empty span (`is-empty` when the post has none), not a `figure > img`; `eyebrow` — the post's category title, upper-cased server-side (`strtoupper($item->category_title)`), plain text rather than `core/post-terms`' link (an `<a>` inside the row's own `<a>` is split apart by the HTML parser); `meta` — author and `M j` date joined into ONE text node with " · ", not two elements.
